device_matrix.input_requirements: dToF LiDAR depth sensor, ARKit visual-inertial odometry 6-DoF poses, and camera intrinsics.

nominal_accuracy.wall_length_error: ≤ 1.0 cm or ≤ 0.5% per wall (exceeds repeatability gate)
nominal_accuracy.ceiling_height: ≤ 1.5 cm absolute error, spread across repeat captures ≤ 1.0 cm
nominal_accuracy.room_adjacency: Pose Graph Optimization with loop closure and plane-anchored constraints

device_matrix.limitations: Range limited to ~5 meters; multipath reflections on mirrored surfaces filtered by confidence thresholding.
